name: sherlock
highlights: -v — Display extra debugging information and metrics.
-fo — If using multiple usernames, the output of the results will be saved to this folder.
-o — If using single username, the output of the result will be saved to this file.
-t — Make requests over Tor; increases runtime; requires Tor to be installed and in system path
-u — Make requests over Tor with new Tor circuit after each request; increases runtime; require
--xlsx — Create the standard file for the modern Microsoft Excel spreadsheet (xlsx).
--site — Limit analysis to just the listed sites. Add multiple options to specify more than one sit

flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: --version
flags.description: Display version information and dependencies.

flags.name: --verbose
flags.description: Display extra debugging information and metrics.

flags.name: --folderoutput
flags.description: If using multiple usernames, the output of the results will be saved to this folder.

flags.name: --output
flags.description: If using single username, the output of the result will be saved to this file.

flags.name: --tor
flags.description: Make requests over Tor; increases runtime; requires Tor to be installed and in system path.

flags.name: --unique-tor
flags.description: Make requests over Tor with new Tor circuit after each request; increases runtime; requires Tor to be installed and in system path.

flags.name: --csv
flags.description: Create Comma-Separated Values (CSV) File.

flags.name: --xlsx
flags.description: Create the standard file for the modern Microsoft Excel spreadsheet (xlsx).

flags.name: --site
flags.description: Limit analysis to just the listed sites. Add multiple options to specify more than one site.

flags.name: --proxy
flags.description: Make requests over a proxy. e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080

flags.name: --dump-response
flags.description: Dump the HTTP response to stdout for targeted debugging.

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Load data from a JSON file or an online, valid, JSON file. Upstream PR numbers also accepted.

flags.name: --timeout
flags.description: Time (in seconds) to wait for response to requests (Default: 60)

flags.name: --print-all
flags.description: Output sites where the username was not found.

flags.name: --print-found
flags.description: Output sites where the username was found (also if exported as file).

flags.name: --no-color
flags.description: Don't color terminal output

flags.name: --browse
flags.description: Browse to all results on default browser.

flags.name: --local
flags.description: Use the local data.json file.

flags.name: --remote
flags.description: Fetch data.json from GitHub instead of the local file.

flags.name: --nsfw
flags.description: Include checking of NSFW sites from default list.

flags.name: --no-txt
flags.description: Disable creation of a txt file

flags.name: --ignore-exclusions
flags.description: Ignore upstream exclusions (may return more false positives)
